Class LocalFiles

java.lang.Object
com.sbancuz.offscreen.api.io.LocalFiles
public final class LocalFiles extends Object
Small UTF-8 settings files and cancellable background directory listings. These operations own no windows or graphics resources. Read/write are synchronous; directory enumeration runs on a bounded shared worker pool and returns immutable data.

  • Method Details

    • readText

      public static String readText(Path path, String fallback) throws IOException
      Reads a small UTF-8 file, or the supplied default if it does not exist. Permission, encoding and I/O failures propagate instead of being mistaken for absence.
      Parameters:
      path - caller-owned file
      fallback - value returned only for a missing file
      Returns:
      decoded document
      Throws:
      IOException - if reading fails or the byte limit is exceeded

    • writeText

      public static void writeText(Path path, String text) throws IOException
      Writes UTF-8 through a temporary sibling and replaces the destination when complete. An atomic move is preferred; filesystems without one use ordinary replacement.
      Parameters:
      path - caller-owned destination
      text - complete new document
      Throws:
      IOException - if writing or replacement fails, or the byte limit is exceeded

    • list

      public static LocalFiles.DirectoryRequest list(Path directory, int limit)
      Starts a bounded directory listing. Poll the request during client updates and close it on disposal.
      Parameters:
      directory - caller-selected directory, never created or modified by enumeration
      limit - maximum returned entries, from 1 through 1000
      Returns:
      caller-owned request; no callback runs on a worker or client thread
